Struct Transform2D

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Core.Structs
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents a 2D transformation, including position, rotation, base size, and scale. Immutable and implements value equality.

public readonly struct Transform2D : IEquatable<Transform2D>

ExpDecayLerp(Transform2D, float, float)

Performs a framerate-independent interpolation between this transform and the target transform using exponential decay. The decay value is interpolated between 1 and 25 based on the given fraction.

public Transform2D ExpDecayLerp(Transform2D to, float f, float dt)

Parameters

dt float

UpdateTransform(Transform2D, Transform2D, bool, bool, bool)

Calculates the absolute transform for a child object based on its relative offset and the parent’s absolute transform.

public static Transform2D UpdateTransform(Transform2D parentTransform, Transform2D childOffset, bool moves = true, bool rotates = true, bool scales = true)

Parameters

parentTransform Transform2D

The absolute Transform2D of the parent.

childOffset Transform2D

The relative Transform2D offset of the child to the parent.

moves bool

If true, the child moves with the parent; if false, the child remains at a fixed position.

rotates bool

If true, the child rotates with the parent; if false, the child retains its own rotation.

scales bool

If true, the child scales with the parent; if false, the child retains its own scale and size.

Returns

Transform2D

The absolute Transform2D of the child, computed from the parent transform and the child offset.
